name: Build inside Kaestral (house rule)
description: The non-negotiable way to work — build every edit ON the Kaestral timeline via MCP tools so the user watches it happen, and render only with Kaestral's own Export. Read before any editing task.

name: Viral-style reel
description: Turn raw footage into a punchy vertical (9:16) short: hook in the first 3s, tight jump cuts, zoom punches, trending captions, and a beat-aware rhythm. Use when asked to 'make this a viral reel / short / TikTok / Reel'.

name: Beat-synced cutting
description: Cut and animate to the music. Use analyze_audio to get beats/onsets, then place cuts and zoom/scale punches on the beat. Use when the edit should feel locked to a track.

name: Creative director (palette, grade, type)
description: Give a clip or project a cohesive look: extract its palette, build a color grade, and pick on-brand type + captions. Use for 'make it look cinematic / on-brand / designed'.

name: Trending caption styles
description: Apply modern short-form caption looks — word-pop, karaoke highlight, bold-boxed, typewriter — with correct sizing/placement for 9:16. Use when adding or restyling on-screen text/captions.

name: B-roll planner
description: Plan and place B-roll cutaways over an A-roll talking track — from the media library or generated (BYOK). Use when the edit needs visual variety or to illustrate what's being said.

name: Platform delivery
description: Package the finished edit for each platform — Reels/TikTok/Shorts (9:16), feed (1:1), YouTube (16:9) — with the right aspect, safe areas, duration, and captions, then export. Use when delivering for social/YouTube.

name: Promo / ad video
description: Build a short promo or ad — hook, benefit beats, and a clear call-to-action — with titles, captions, music, and pacing. Use for 'make a promo / ad / product video'.

name: Art direction (motion)
description: Master motion-designer playbook for composing premium films with compose_motion — the decision process, optical composition, rhythm, restraint, transition craft, and the physics of premium motion, with worked examples and failure modes. Read this BEFORE composing any motion piece (launch film, product reel, title sequence, brand sting).

name: Shot recipes (motion grammar)
description: A library of ~26 named, composable shots for compose_motion — openers, product/UI shots, data & proof, emphasis accents, transitions, atmosphere, closers — each mapped to exact SceneSpec fields, plus film-level composition patterns. Use WITH art-direction: principles there, vocabulary here.

name: Topic → short video
description: Turn a topic or script into a complete, editable short ON the timeline: write/approve the script, beat it into scenes, source visuals honestly (user media, hosted generation if configured, or composed motion), time to VO/music, caption word-accurately, brand, grade, quality-gate, export. Use for 'make a video about X' / 'turn this script into a short'.

name: Multi-language delivery
description: One edit → many language variants: transcript → translated caption sets (you translate; timings from the source words) → per-language exports + SRT sidecars, with naming conventions and a QA checklist. Use for 'deliver this in Spanish/Hindi/…'.

name: Brand kit
description: Establish and apply one brand system across a project — palette (extract_palette), type scale, logo bug placement + safe margins, lower-third recipes, and a reusable apply_color grade preset. Use for 'keep everything on-brand' / multi-clip client work.

name: Batch variants
description: Produce testable variants of one edit — hook variants, caption-style variants, length variants, aspect variants — one variable per variant, master-project workflow, and a filename scheme that maps results back. Use for 'make versions to A/B test'.

name: Client review cut
description: Prepare a review deliverable: version slate, low-opacity watermark, compressed 720p proxy export — and turn client notes into precise timeline edits (applied bottom-up so timestamps stay valid). Use for 'send a review cut' / handling feedback rounds.

name: Podcast → clips
description: Long recording → publishable 9:16 clip SET: segment by real cuts ∩ sentence boundaries, rank with the viral-reel rubric, then per clip — isolate, speaker framing, tighten, hook, captions, brand, export, reset. Use for 'clip this podcast/stream'.

name: Hook engineering
description: The first 1–3 seconds as a craft: an 8-device hook taxonomy, finding the hook in real footage (transcript + see_video), the cold-open restructure, text-hook specs, and open loops that resolve at the end. Use whenever a video must stop the scroll.

name: Retention editing
description: Pacing for watch-through: cut-cadence targets by section, the change toolkit (dead-air removal, punches, caption pulse, B-roll relief), what to cut when a section drags, and loop-friendly endings. Use for 'people drop off' / tighten-this asks.

name: Thumbnail & cover
description: Choose and build the cover frame: candidate frames via see_video, composition + legibility-at-20% rules, overlay text discipline, punchier cover grade — with the honest export paths (no single-image export tool exists yet). Use for 'make a thumbnail/cover'.

name: Talking-head cleanup
description: The standard creator pass as one ordered pipeline: fillers (remove_words) → silence jump-cuts → breaths → framing correction → captions → light grade → verify + export, with sensible defaults. Use for 'clean this up' on face-to-camera footage.

name: Ad creative (direct response)
description: Direct-response short-form ads: the hook → problem → proof → offer → CTA spine with per-beat time budgets, proof via compose_motion (counter/split/screenMock), on-screen text discipline, and a strict no-invented-claims rule. Use for paid-traffic ad asks.

name: Sound design
description: Audio as craft: the VO/music/SFX level hierarchy, keyframed ducking with asymmetric ramps, beat-aware music entry/exit (analyze_audio), engineered silence as punctuation, SFX placement — honest about the absence of a loudness meter. Use for any mix pass.

name: Transition craft
description: When each of the 7 transitions is right and wrong, overlap-frame tuning per kind, beat-snapping via beatMarkers, and the restraint law: one statement transition per film, most cuts should be cuts. Use when choosing or tuning any transition.

name: Text & typography
description: On-screen text beyond captions: hierarchy sizes, per-platform safe areas, readability armor over busy footage (boxed/outlined/dimmed), animation selection, kinetic-type patterns, and read-time budgets. Use for hooks, lower-thirds, CTAs, type beats.

name: Color storytelling
description: Grading with intent: correct → match → grade order, shot matching to a reference, mood via temperature/curves/wheels, palette-driven grades from extract_palette, hue-curve surgery, LUT discipline at 0.4–0.7 strength, and over-grading failures. Use for any look pass.
